bn_librarian.text: The Beaney was left to the city by James Beaney, who ran away to be a surgeon's apprentice and ended up famous in Melbourne. He wanted a library for working men. He got that and a museum.
Upstairs there's a whole room of cows by Thomas Sidney Cooper. He painted cattle for seventy years. He had very strong opinions about cows.

bn_bagpuss.text: Bagpuss was made near here! Oliver Postgate and Peter Firmin made their programmes in a barn at Blean, just up the road. The Beaney has a little exhibition about them.
